content.eyebrow: Open engine or the hosted platform
content.title:
Run the open engine yourself
or use the hosted platform?
content.lead:
Both options run the same engine on the same files. The difference is what a team needs around it,
from scheduling and alerts to access control, a catalog and support.

content.title: What changes after you switch
content.body: Teams that move from a self-managed setup to the hosted platform report gains in speed, reliability and the time engineers spend on infrastructure.

cards.label: faster onboarding for new analysts joining a project
less engineering time spent maintaining infrastructure
job success rate reported across hosted plans

highlight.title: Hosted Lattice
items: Catalog and lineage
Role-based access
Alerts to owners

cards.label: Self-managed
cards.title: Maintaining the plumbing yourself
items: Patch and upgrade the engine on every server by hand, then hope nothing breaks
Write and babysit custom scripts that schedule and retry jobs overnight
Build your own alerting and dig through logs when something fails
Field access requests one by one and track them in a spreadsheet

cards.label: Hosted platform
cards.title: Spending time on the models
items: Upgrades roll out automatically with release notes and a safe rollback
Jobs, retries and state-aware builds are configured in a few clicks
Failures alert the right owner with the error and the lineage attached
Access follows roles and groups from your identity provider by default

cards.label: Self-managed
cards.title: Waiting on the setup
items: Install tools locally and ask an engineer when the environment breaks
Wait for someone else to run a job before you can see your changes
Hunt for the right table without descriptions, owners or lineage
Copy queries between tools and hope the definitions still match

cards.label: Hosted platform
cards.title: Building from the browser
items: Open the browser editor or canvas and start building with no setup at all
Preview results instantly and open a pull request when you are ready
Search the catalog for certified models with owners and descriptions
Use shared metrics that match every dashboard across the company

cards.label: Self-managed
cards.title: Hidden costs adding up
items: Engineers spend their weeks on infrastructure instead of data products
No clear view of what runs, how long it takes or what it costs
Security reviews stall on questions nobody can answer quickly
Knowledge lives in the heads of one or two senior people

cards.label: Hosted platform
cards.title: Visibility and control
items: Engineering time goes back into the models the business depends on
Run history, costs and health are visible to everyone who needs them
Single sign-on, audit logs and certifications answer security questions
Documentation and lineage make the project easy for anyone to pick up
